from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import Descriptors

# p-Propionylbenzoic acid
# benzoic acid = C6H4(COOH)
# p-propionyl = -C(=O)CH2CH3 at para position
# Formula: C10 H10 O3
# SMILES: CCC(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)cc1
smi_propionylbenzoic = "CCC(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)cc1"
mol1 = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi_propionylbenzoic)
mw1 = Descriptors.MolWt(mol1)

# Allyl iodide
# Allyl group = CH2=CH-CH2-
# iodide = I
# Formula: C3 H5 I
# SMILES: C=CCI
smi_allyl_iodide = "C=CCI"
mol2 = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi_allyl_iodide)
mw2 = Descriptors.MolWt(mol2)

print(f"p-Propionylbenzoic acid: SMILES={smi_propionylbenzoic}, MW={mw1:.4f} Da")
print(f"Allyl iodide: SMILES={smi_allyl_iodide}, MW={mw2:.4f} Da")
